text:
noah: Kicking off config-only deploy for the small-latency cluster in tonight's change window (01:00-02:00 PT). Goal: reduce median queue time for short prompts. No model changes.

noah: Config diff (high level): batch.max_wait_ms 50 -> 20; routing.weight_floor 0.06 -> 0.11; batching.max_batch_tokens 1024 -> 768; concurrency.soft_limit 5 -> 7. Canary -> 10% -> 40% -> 100%.

tara: +1. Product OK. Will track cost delta and any increase in tokenization overhead.

deploy-bot: [queued] config-push config-2026-03-22 -> canary (target=small-latency) by noah. runbook: https://go/release/config-2026-03-22-runbook

noah: Ops checks: rollback if any top-20 tenant error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR P99 increases by >60ms. Also watch host memory: concurrency bump can increase resident set.

infra-watch: Prewarmed 2 extra canary hosts. Starting canary at 01:05 PT with 5% traffic. Hosts: r-small-can-21/22.

deploy-bot: [started] canary live at 01:06 PT

infra-watch: Canary metrics after 7m: P95 -5ms, P99 +6ms, error_rate unchanged. No OOMs.

tara: Running quick smoke tests (short-queries-200). Output fidelity looks identical.

noah: Proceed to 10% in 10m if no flags.

deploy-bot: [in-progress] ramp to 10% at 01:20 PT

infra-watch: At 10% we saw a brief spike in 502s from tenant 710 tied to upstream edge (not model). Opened INF-4934.

ops-oncall: Watching. We'll hold if any tenant error_rate > 0.5% for 3m. INF-4934 appears edge-related, not model.

noah: Hold at 10% while edge team mitigates.

infra-watch: Edge fix applied. Tenant 710 error_rate returned to baseline. No model errors.

deploy-bot: [resume] ramp to 40% at 01:35 PT

infra-watch: At 40% P99 delta ~18ms (expected with lower batch wait), throughput up slightly. Memory usage per host within margins.

tara: Cost team: estimated token cost up ~2.1% due to concurrency. Product accepts.

noah: Good. Ramp to 100% over 3 staged steps. Keep auto-rollback watch active.

deploy-bot: [ramping] 60% -> 80% -> 100% (staggered)

infra-watch: At 100% (01:54 PT): overall error_rate stable, P95 better, P99 within threshold. One long-tail spike for tenant 412 (0.35% 502s) correlated with an unrelated edge flurry.

ops-oncall: No automated rollback triggers fired. Keeping 3h watch.

noah: Tagged config as config-2026-03-22 in changelog and pinned in control plane. Post-roll checklist: update dashboards, add owners to watch, schedule 12h check-in.

tara: Dashboards updated, changelog entry added: "config-2026-03-22: reduced batch max_wait, raised routing floor, increased soft concurrency." Owners: noah, tara, infra-watch.

deploy-bot: [complete] rollout finished at 01:54 PT.

noah: Closing thread; reopen if you see anomalies. Thanks everyone :rocket:
